verdict.rationale: vLLM's own server exposes an interactive API explorer by default: a FastAPI Swagger UI and ReDoc at the /docs endpoint, with toggle flags and an offline mode for air-gapped use. This explorer exists only on a self-hosted running instance, not as a hosted interactive reference. The evidence also never states that runnable examples or try-it requests are provided. missing for 10: hosted interactive API reference, explicitly documented runnable examples or try-it calls, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The vendor documents the built-in interactive /docs explorer (FastAPI Swagger UI, plus ReDoc per the CLI reference) on every served endpoint, including an air-gapped mode with vendored static assets.
Disable FastAPI's OpenAPI schema, Swagger UI, and ReDoc endpoint. Default: False
